title: Monthly Specials
intro: Ongoing design for an international bar in Busan: a new specials menu every month, plus posters for its events. One visual voice, a different theme every time.
brief: Hideout's owners create new signature cocktails every month, each around a different theme: a flavour, a mood or a technique. Alongside them, the bar runs special events of every kind. Each piece needs to feel distinct and bring its theme forward, while clearly belonging to the same bar, and the menus need both an English and a Korean version.
did: I treat it all as one series with a consistent structure, type hierarchy and voice, so guests recognise Hideout at a glance. Everything around that core shifts to fit the month or the event.
Each menu is laid out twice. Korean and English differ a lot in length and rhythm, so each version is rebalanced instead of just translated in place.
There's no budget for a studio shoot every time, so the drinks are photographed on a phone at the bar, then reworked in Photoshop with AI-assisted editing until they hold up as menu imagery.
coverAlt: Hideout monthly specials menus and event posters
